weekly_objective: Protect recovery after Tuesday's double hard day while maintaining aerobic volume, deferring further quality work until readiness rebounds.
coach_says: Your readiness dropped 25 points and ATL spiked hard after Tuesday's AM/PM double — a clear sign the body hasn't caught up yet, even though TSB and HRV still look okay. I've pulled Thursday's threshold intervals back to an easy spin, swapped Friday's gym to upper-body/core to keep your legs fully fresh (the original lower-body session sat too close to Saturday's long ride), and trimmed Saturday's long ride slightly. We'll pick the aerobic-high quality work back up once recovery-time and sleep factors move out of 'moderate.'

days.session: Workout A — Upper body, core & hip stability
days.details: Lunch session (wet day, indoor). Warm-up: 8 min easy spin bike + band pull-aparts and hip openers. Main: Pull-ups 4x6, DB Bench Press 3x8, Single-Arm DB Row 3x10/side, Pallof Press 3x12/side, Side Plank 3x40s, Copenhagen Plank 3x20s, Glute Bridge 3x12 (light). Rest 90s between sets. Objective: strength stimulus for upper body, trunk and hip stability while keeping legs completely fresh for tomorrow's committed double hard day. No heavy lower-body loading today.

days.session: AM Hills road ride + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details: AM (before work, ~60 min | Primary objective: aerobic-high stimulus | Zone 3-4): Warm-up 12 min Z1-2, then ride 4-5 climbs of 5-8 min each at sustained tempo-to-threshold effort (Z3 low Z4, RPE 7), seated and controlled — resist surging over the top. Easy spin descents as recovery. Cool-down 8 min. PM (~90 min): Committed hard MTB group ride — dry conditions, go hard, but cap the number of max-effort sprints; your anaerobic load is already 134 over target, so favour sustained pressure over repeated punches. Fuel well between sessions and prioritise an early night.

Lunch swim, strictly recovery after Tuesday's double. Warmup: 200m easy freestyle, focus on long relaxed strokes. Main set: 4x100m easy (25m drill of choice + 75m smooth swim), 20s rest; then 4x50m easy pull with buoy, 15s rest. Cooldown: 200m very easy mixed strokes. Total: 1000m. Effort throughout RPE 3-4 max — this is blood flow and movement, not fitness. If shoulders or body feel heavy, cut the main set short or swap for 30 min gentle yoga.

Good weather window, but readiness has dropped sharply this week (75 to 50) with ATL climbing fast — this is a recovery-priority ride, not a quality session. Total 50 min | Zone 1-2 only, conversational pace throughout, RPE 3-4. No intervals, no surges. Flat-to-rolling terrain preferred over hills. Cool-down easy. The aerobic-high gap can wait until recovery is back on track — pushing threshold work now would only dig the hole deeper.

days.session: Workout B — Upper body & core (legs protected for Saturday)
days.details: Lunch session. Warm-up: 8 min easy bike + shoulder and thoracic mobility. Main: DB Incline Press 3x8, Chin-ups 3x6-8, Cable Row 3x10, Pallof Press 3x12/side, Dead Bug 3x10/side, Side Plank 3x40s, Farmer Carry 3x40m. Rest 90s between sets. Switched from the original posterior-chain/single-leg session to protect your legs fully — heavy lower-body work sits too close to tomorrow's long ride, and fatigue is already elevated this week. Strength stimulus maintained via upper body and trunk work instead.

Rain risk remains this weekend, so staying on the trainer. Total 1h50 (trimmed from the original 2h15 given this week's fatigue accumulation) | Primary objective: aerobic base volume without digging a deeper hole | Zone 2, conversational pace throughout, RPE 4-5. No intervals, no low-cadence blocks this week — just steady, easy riding. Fuel from the start (60g+ carbs/hour), fan on. Keep it fully disciplined; this is about maintaining aerobic volume while recovery catches up, not adding load.

40 min gentle yoga/mobility flow: focus on hip flexors, hamstrings, glutes, thoracic spine and lower back after a demanding week. Long holds (60-90s), nasal breathing, nothing strenuous. Otherwise fully switch off, eat well, and get to bed early — sleep-tonight and recovery-time were your weakest readiness factors this week, so prioritise banking hours to head into next week properly recovered.
